questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte Hong Kong som udvekslingsdestination, fordi byen tilbyder et unikt akademisk miljø i krydsfeltet mellem øst og vest samt et indblik i globale, sociale og kulturelle dynamikker, der er relevante for mit studie.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var relativt nemt at finde den nødvendige information, da universitetet stillede klare retningslinjer og deadlines og var hurtige til at svare på mails, hvis man havde spørgsmål.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var 2 korte introdage hvor vi blev vidst rundt og fik information om byen, universitetet mm.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt nok. Jeg havde aftalt at bo sammen med 3 andre danskere hjemmefra så vi fandt en Airbnb sammen.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det koster en del mere end at bo på campus. Jeg vil anbefale at bo sammen med andre hvis ikke man vælger at bo på campus da det måske kan gå hen at blive lidt ensomt. Jeg valgte ikke at bo på campus fordi jeg gerne ville bo lokalt og tættere på centrum.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Universitetet gav på forhånd klare trin-for-trin-instruktioner med vigtige deadlines og nødvendige dokumenter, og der var let adgang til support via mail, hvis der opstod spørgsmål.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kunne enten ringe eller skrive til dem. Dog skal man være lidt opmærksom på tidsforskellen.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik næsten alle de fag jeg ville. Der var lidt bøvl med det, men det løste sig i sidste ende.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: At sætte sig grundigt ind i fagene og deres krav for at bestå. Derudover er det en god idé at søge forhåndsgodkendelse til flere fag, end dem man umiddelbart ønsker, da man ikke er 100 procent sikker på at få sine førstevalg - og det derfor er vigtigt at have en plan B.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det faglige niveau var til at overskue, hverken for svært eller for nemt.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det afhænger af hvilke fag man vælger, men man skal være forberedt på at arbejde meget i grupper. Derudover har de fleste fag også præsentationer og løbende quiz/tests.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
GE1137	Movies and Psychology
GE2129	Psychology for Young Professionals
GE2211	Sexuality, Culture and Diversity
GE2248	Persuasion in Everyday Life
PIA3544	East Asia and Globalization

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Dem jeg havde, var alle ret gode. De havde løbende bedømmelse, hvilket vil sige at du ikke kun bliver vurderet på en enkelt eksamen, men at test, præsentationer, fremmøde mm. tæller med i den endelige karakter.

Food DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Rejser til andre lande i Asien

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Ved ikke

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var pool og fitness på uni samt andre sportshold og klubber/fællesskaber man kunne tilmelde sig. Jeg brugte det dog ikke.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tag ud og se naturen! Hong Kong har virkelig gode Hikes og flotte strande. Besøg de små øer!.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag på ture til nabolandene eller til Mainland(Kina). Tiden går virkelig hurtigt når først man er afsted så det er bare med at opleve når man har muligheden. Ellers har Hong Kong et nice byliv og virkelig gode shopping muligheder.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det tog lige en uges tid men det afhænger nok lidt af hvem man er som person. Der er så meget som er anderledes, men det er det hele værd!.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Universitetet tilbyde ofte ture man kan tilmelde sig - benyt det!.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ved ikke.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Det hele.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Vær åben og opsøgende, forbered dig på en anderledes studie- og undervisningskultur, og brug udvekslingen aktivt til både faglig og kulturel læring. Derudover tag på
Mr.Wong
(virkelig billige øl :)) alle udvekslingsstuderende i byen samles ofte der og det er altid nemt at møde nye bekendtskaber der.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Sørg for at være ude i god tid med praktiske forhold som bolig og engagér dig socialt, da det har stor betydning for at man ikke bliver føler sig alene i en kæmpe by hvor alt er fremmed til at starte med.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At blive udfordret både fagligt og personligt ved at studere og bo i en helt anden kulturel kontekst end den, jeg er vant til.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At ville nå det hele: Hong Kong har enormt meget at byde på og ligger perfekt i forhold til billige rejser til andre spændende destinationer, men på kun fire måneder er det umuligt at opleve det hele - så sørg for at lave en god plan og en klar prioriteringsliste.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
